items.rationale: Section 5.2.6(b) covers the initial assessment; the €524 benchmark is below the separate €3,000 limit. The €500 deductible applies once to the event, not separately to this line.

Section 5.2.6(a) covers locating the porous spots. Case 20's €707 bundled benchmark, less €150 for separately billed technician time and €79 for travel, supports about €478; detection and technician time together stay below €1,000.

Section 5.2.6(a) expressly covers on-site technician time, and the detection line does not say it includes this labour. At €60 per hour, the line is €150, within the shared €1,000 leak-location limit.
Section 5.2.6(c) allows one qualifying vehicle charge on this contractor's invoice. The €79 benchmark is below the €83.30 gross cap at 19% VAT.

items.description: Repair of two verified leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 treats material-ageing leaks as fracture damage on sections shown to be leaking, and section 7.1.1(b) covers the necessary local repair. Allow about €320 for sealing or locally renewing the two joints, excluding the wider replacement.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking copper run
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.5 exclude sections not shown to be leaking, so the expected payment is zero. The positive figure is a conditional estimate for like-for-like replacement of the run if it were covered.
Section 7.1.9 limits reinstatement to the pre-loss specification, so none of this separately billed upgrade premium is payable. The positive figure is a conditional estimate only.
Section 5.2.6(c) allows one vehicle charge on the plumber's separate invoice for the covered joint repairs. The €79 benchmark is below the €83.30 gross cap at 19% VAT.
